## Chapter Summary

Experimental design is a fundamental approach enabling the investigation of causal relationships between variables. This chapter introduces RCTs, A/B testing, sampling methods, and the foundations of data modeling.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Skills you will acquire in this chapter
- Understand principles of experimental design (RCTs, quasi-experimental)
- Define and classify variables: independent, dependent, confounding
- Design and analyze A/B tests and matched-pair models
- Understand internal vs external validity
- Introduction to the data mining project lifecycle
:::
